statement: Between 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-11, at least one of the five men arrested on 2026-09-27 near RAF Fairford on suspicion of Explosives Act offences and preparing a terrorist act is formally charged with a criminal offence arising from those arrests.
resolution: Counter Terrorism Policing, the CPS, or a court record confirms a charge against at least one of the five men, dated between 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-11, arising from the 2026-09-27 RAF Fairford arrests.
failure_condition: As of 2026-10-14, every one of the five men arrested on 2026-09-27 near RAF Fairford has been released without charge, released under investigation, or held uncharged.

statement: Between 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-20, the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog adds at least one further Citrix NetScaler vulnerability, beyond the two Citrix NetScaler entries added on 2026-09-27.
resolution: CISA KEV JSON contains an entry with vendorProject Citrix, product referencing NetScaler, dateAdded between 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-20 inclusive, and a cveID different from the two Citrix entries dated 2026-09-27.
failure_condition: On 2026-10-22 the CISA KEV catalog holds no Citrix NetScaler entry, other than the two dated 2026-09-27, with dateAdded between 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-20.

statement: Between 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-20, the FBI publicly attributes the roughly 387.5 million dollar theft from the Bitget exchange on 2026-09-24 to North Korea or a named North Korean hacking group.
resolution: An FBI public service announcement or press release on IC3.gov or fbi.gov, dated between 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-20, names North Korea or a North Korean group as responsible for the Bitget theft.
failure_condition: No FBI public service announcement or press release dated between 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-20 names North Korea or a North Korean group as responsible for the Bitget theft.

statement: Between 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-30, the FRED series DGS10 (10-year Treasury constant maturity yield) records a value at or above 5.50 percent on at least one business day. Reference: 5.27 percent per the packet market snapshot; FRED DGS10 was 5.18 percent on 2026-09-24.
resolution: At least one FRED DGS10 observation dated between 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-30 is 5.50 or higher. Reference: 5.27 percent per the packet market snapshot on 2026-09-28.
failure_condition: Every FRED DGS10 observation dated between 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-30 is below 5.50 percent.

statement: On 2026-09-29 the Reserve Bank of Australia board announces an increase in the cash rate target. Reference: cash rate target of 4.35 percent before the meeting.
resolution: The RBA media release for the 2026-09-29 monetary policy decision states a new cash rate target above the 4.35 percent reference.
failure_condition: The RBA media release for 2026-09-29 leaves the cash rate target at 4.35 percent or sets it lower.

statement: Between 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-30, the US President or a federal agency signs or issues an order, proclamation, or rule that prohibits, restricts, or caps exports of diesel fuel from the United States. Voluntary industry export restraint does not count.
resolution: whitehouse.gov, the Federal Register, or a BIS or Commerce notice shows a mandatory diesel export ban, licensing requirement, or quota signed or issued between 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-30; voluntary export restraint does not count.
failure_condition: No mandatory federal restriction on diesel exports is signed or issued between 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-30.

statement: Between 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-31, OFAC designates at least one entity located outside Iran for supporting Iranian airlines or the Iranian aviation sector.
resolution: A US Treasury press release or OFAC Recent Actions SDN list update dated between 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-31 designates an entity located outside Iran and cites support to Iranian airlines or the Iranian aviation sector.
failure_condition: No OFAC designation dated between 2026-10-01 and 2026-10-31 of an entity located outside Iran cites support to Iranian airlines or the Iranian aviation sector.

statement: Between 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-05, Hurricane Polo makes landfall on mainland Mexico after crossing the Baja California peninsula, with National Hurricane Center advisories giving maximum sustained winds of at least 74 mph at that landfall.
resolution: The first NHC advisory or bulletin reporting that Polo has made landfall on or moved inland over mainland Mexico, dated between 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-05, gives maximum sustained winds of 74 mph or higher.
failure_condition: The first NHC advisory reporting Polo onshore over mainland Mexico gives maximum sustained winds below 74 mph, or Polo dissipates before reaching the mainland.

statement: Between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-04, US forces conduct at least one acknowledged air or missile strike on a land target or island inside Iran.
resolution: A US government statement, or Reuters and AP reporting, confirms a US air or missile strike on a land target or island inside Iranian territory carried out between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-04.
failure_condition: No US air or missile strike on a land target or island inside Iran takes place between 2026-11-04 and 2026-12-04.

statement: Between 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-16, the Australian Greens party room elects a new federal parliamentary leader to replace Larissa Waters, who announced on 2026-09-28 that she is stepping down.
resolution: The Greens or two of ABC, Guardian Australia, and AAP report a party room vote choosing a new federal leader between 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-16; acting or interim appointments do not count.
failure_condition: No new federal leader of the Australian Greens has been chosen by party room vote between 2026-09-29 and 2026-10-16.
